trust.machine: vm_stat wired + anonymous + compressor. Activity-monitor 'used' counts purgeable/file cache and is not used for admission.
trust.do_not_trust: ps RSS. At N=4 seq=2048, RSS was 5.92-12.89 GB while phys_footprint was 15.96 GB on every pid. RSS undercounts Metal wired and would overcount shared file pages if the artifact were actually mapped.
trust.why_not_shared: Each child copies the catalog into a private IOAccelerator buffer. mapped-file clean is ~4.5 MB, not the 8.5 GB artifact. IOAccelerator dirty is identical across children at the same seq-len (14,476,197,888 B at seq=128; 14,727,856,128 B at seq=2048).

n8.reason: N=4 at seq-len 2048 already used 751 MB swap with 0.81 GB free. 8 * 15.659 GB phys = 125.3 GB against a 96 GB box. Launching it would swap and make every number a lie.

throughput_knee.why: One child already moves 13.618 GB/token at 401.6/411.51 GB/s. Extra children partition the same DRAM. N=2 recovers the leftover host/encoder slack. N=3 is flat. N=4 is worse and swaps.
throughput_knee.short_generate_warning: For 8-token TEXT evals the Metal upload dominates. N=1 was 5.37-7.25 s; N=4 was 42.82 s. Do not cold-start four children for a short recipe eval.

A_gravity_recipe.parallelizes: per-layer / per-tensor assignment evals, up to recommended_operating_n=2 (hard cap safe_n=3)
A_gravity_recipe.why_not_more: Metal weight copies are private; GPU bandwidth is already ~98% of the honest decode ceiling on one child.

B_kernel_floor.parallelizes: build/setup of candidate N+1 (compile, pack, shader) as a no-lock child
B_kernel_floor.lock_bound: the generate that produces a complete-token wall. gpu_lane_lock.sh serializes those.
B_kernel_floor.why_lock: A contended TIMING is not a number. The 35,227,918 ns ledger was taken under the lock.
